assertionUnion.substitution: Only replace the identical existing owner call expression by already-captured catalog; preserve expected literal and diagnostic template verbatim.

operativeInputEquivalence: Both callbacks loop literal [false,true] and call resolveCheckoutPricingCatalog({source:"premium_sheet",launchPricingEnabled}) exactly once per row. Pure owner reads only those fields and standard literal/flag resolver. Keeper uses same result for subsequent price comparisons; transfer occurs before any row helper or price-ID lookup. No fixture, flag environment, owner call, case, loop row, skip or expectation change.
limits: Static pure helper/catalog alignment; keeper does not invoke POST or provider. Configured Stripe price equality may be vacuous for absent IDs, so separate literal standard-price test stays. This consolidation does not strengthen that inherited limit.
